_comment: Curated GGUF models per device tier. Every sha256 is pinned (checked 2026-10-25 against the Hugging Face API and a real download for qwen2.5-coder-1.5b, qwen3-1.7b and qwen3-4b). For a new entry leave sha256 empty: scripts/fetch-model.sh then reads the official hash from the Hugging Face API and prints it so you can pin it here.

models.notes: Smoke test only. Too weak for real coding.
Default for phones with 6-8 GB RAM. Calls tools correctly (reads files); edits often fail. Official Qwen quantization.
Phones with 12+ GB RAM or PCs. Calls tools correctly, about 2.5x slower than qwen3-1.7b. Official Qwen quantization.
Answers in chat, but in the 2026-10-25 test it wrote tool calls as plain text instead of calling them, so OpenCode cannot use it as an agent. Kept for comparison.
